runtimeContribution: The React web bootstrap supplies matching content templates with label, zones, starter blocks, and content-block renderers; manifest metadata provides the stable template ids used by install-time page provisioning

manifest template ids resolve to runtime content templates with label + zones + starter blocks
install auto-creates editable page rows and publishes them so /login, /register, etc. are live immediately
owner edits to page copy persist across re-enable; starter blocks apply only to newly provisioned page rows
